title: Multi-Agent Consensus Protocols for Distributed Autonomous Scientific Exploration
summary: Coordinating swarms of autonomous research agents requires robust decentralized consensus to avoid redundant experimentation. We introduce a Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus mechanism tailored for asynchronous multi-agent scientific discovery. On networks of 64 autonomous nodes, our protocol reduces redundant computational trials by 76.4% and reaches convergence within 1.84 seconds under adversarial network partitions.
